seo.Title: Feds Invest $25M in Langley’s New Concert & Performance Hall
seo.Meta description: The federal government will invest $25M to build a 1,600-seat, net-zero Concert and Performance Hall at the Langley Events Centre—creating a cultural hub for Langley and the Fraser Valley.
